stringUnit.value: Keep the surroundings typical and steady while we measure two seconds of background sound.
测量环境音的两秒内，请保持环境声音自然、稳定。
Hold the phone in your starting position for 1.2 seconds.
请将手机保持在起始姿势 1.2 秒。
Tilt gently to move the ball into the edges.
轻轻倾斜手机，让球碰到边缘。
Tiles and line progress come from the server. Reward labels describe the configured rewards, not a claim or payout receipt.
格子与连线进度由服务端返回。奖励文案是配置说明，不代表已兑换或已到账。
This part of the story has reached its end.
The camera isn’t available right now
Take a photo for this task. Nothing is uploaded until you review the separate upload step.
为当前任务拍摄照片。只有确认单独的上传步骤后才会上传。
Use the camera for this task?
Scan the task’s QR code with your camera.
用相机扫一扫任务二维码。
Start is confirmed by the server first. Local measurements do not award a result or reward.
先由服务端确认开局。本地测量不代表通过或获得奖励。
This attempt reached its time limit
The attempt was interrupted. Start again to measure a fresh attempt.
本次尝试已中断，请重新开始计量。
This is your device measurement. Submit it for the server’s decision.
这是设备测量值，提交后由服务端判定。
Choose a category for every item. You can change any choice before submitting.
为每张卡选择一个分类，提交前都可以修改。
Indoor magnetic interference can make the compass inaccurate. This reading is not proof of arrival.
室内磁场干扰可能造成罗盘偏差。此读数不能作为到店凭证。
Heading accuracy is too low. Move away from magnetic interference.
方位精度不足，请远离磁场干扰。
Waiting for an actual compass reading
正在等待真实罗盘读数
This game can’t open right now. Refresh and try again.
这个小游戏暂时打不开，请刷新后再试。
Your words will be left for the next visitor.
这句话会留给下一位来访者。
Leave a line for the next visitor
给下一位来访者留一句
Anything you haven’t submitted will be cleared.
还没提交的内容会被清除。
Only your chosen position is submitted. Target locations and hit decisions remain on the server.
只提交你点选的位置，目标位置与命中判定由服务端保管。
点一下你发现它的位置
This task’s image host is not approved yet
任务图片来源尚未获准加载
图片无法加载，请尝试刷新。
Pair each left item with a right item. Reusing a right item removes its previous pairing.
为每个左侧条目选择一个右侧条目。重复选择同一个右侧条目会解除它原先的配对。
This message may be shown to later participants
这条留言可能展示给后来的参与者
Your last action is still on its way. Wait for it before trying again.
刚才的操作还在路上，等它落定再继续。
Your photo is in. The story goes on.
照片已经收下，故事会继续。
Framing reference. The native camera framing overlay still requires acceptance.
取景参考。原生相机内的轮廓叠加仍待验收。
No visual-review decision was available for this attempt
这次未能获得视觉审核结论
Only the uploaded image address is submitted. The server performs the visual check; no local score is sent.
仅提交上传后的图片地址。由服务端进行视觉审核，不上报本地分数。
This photo exceeds the 10 MB task upload limit
这张照片超过任务上传的 10 MB 限制
The photo uploads first; you submit it afterwards.
照片会先上传，之后由你确认提交。
This photo can’t be uploaded right now
暂时无法上传这张照片
照片已上传，任务尚未提交
The answer isn’t out yet. Check back later.
答案还没揭晓，过些时候再来看看。
Your profile is set once submitted. Check each answer first.
提交后档案就定下来了，先看看每一项。
A sound crossed the limit. The measured hold has ended.
声音超过阈值，本次保持测量已结束。
Too early. This round did not count.
抢跑了，本轮不计入成绩。
Only the overall decision comes back from the server. No individual answer is revealed or guessed here.
这里只显示服务端的整体判定，不揭露或猜测每一项答案。
还差一点，调整一下再交。
Completion and rewards are based only on the server’s returned state
是否完成及奖励仅以服务端返回状态为准
Once confirmed, it becomes part of the story and can’t be undone.
确认后就写进故事里，提交后不能撤回。
已识别二维码，尚未验证
Overlay and AR replies need an approved native renderer. No substitute result is shown.
显形与 AR 回复需要已验收的原生渲染器，当前不展示替代结果。
Only the volume is measured; nothing is recorded.
检查传感器权限并校准
This game isn’t available on this device yet.
这个小游戏暂时还不能在这台设备上玩。
This attempt was interrupted. Start again when you are ready.
本次尝试已中断。准备好后请重新开始。
Fresh sensor readings stopped or were invalid. No missing time was counted. Please try again.
实时传感器读数已停止或无效。未计入缺失时段，请重试。
Sensor permission was denied. You can change it in system Settings, then try again.
传感器权限被拒绝。您可以在系统设置中修改权限后重试。
The required sensor is unavailable on this device.
此设备无法使用所需的传感器。
This is a device measurement. Only the server can accept it and determine the result.
这是设备测量结果。是否接受以及最终结果均由服务器决定。
正在使用实时读数校准
Done — submit to see how you did
Tilt gently to roll the ball into the edges. Hold on tight and watch your step.
轻轻倾斜手机，让小球碰到四边。请握稳手机，留意脚下。
Hold the phone upright, turn toward the target and hold steady.
竖着拿好手机，转向目标方向并稳住。
Once it starts, stay quiet until time runs out.
开始后保持安静，直到计时结束。
Once it starts, keep the volume up — a dip resets the clock. Pick a suitable spot and stay comfortable.
开始后持续大声喊，音量一降计时就重来。选个合适的地方，量力而行。
The challenge will start only after the server acknowledges your reviewed request.
核对请求并获得服务器确认后，挑战才会开始。
Your account changed. Go back and reopen this.
账号状态有变化，请返回后重新打开。
Keep the volume above the limit continuously. A drop resets the hold.
请持续保持音量超过阈值。音量下降会将保持时间清零。
Arrange the items in order. Use the arrow buttons to move an item one place.
按顺序排列条目，用箭头按钮每次移动一格。
Elapsed time hidden. Tap stop when you think the target time has arrived.
计时读数已隐藏，请在你认为到达目标时间时停止。
Letter case is ignored by the task
本题不区分英文字母大小写
请保持英文字母大小写一致
这个小游戏已经收起来了
The goal is set by the merchant and cannot be changed here
目标由商家设定，不能在这里修改
No verified step reading has been returned
尚未返回经验证的步数
Steps sync in the WeChat mini program.
步数需要在微信小程序里同步。
Compare both records and mark every missing or changed entry. You can select entries from either timeline.
对照两份记录，标出所有缺失或被改动的条目，可从任一侧多选。
The server marked the complete selection correct.
Something’s still off. Compare again closely.
还有地方没找对，再仔细对照看看。
The puzzle just updated. Load the latest marks before continuing.
题目刚刚更新了，请先载入最新的标记再继续。
Replace your current marks with the ones you last submitted?
用上次提交的标记替换现在的选择？
This puzzle can’t open right now. Refresh and try again.
这道题暂时打不开，请刷新后再试。
These marks are submitted together as one attempt.
以下标记会一起提交，算作一次作答。
No entries marked. Submitting still counts as an attempt.
未标记任何条目，提交仍计作一次作答。
This round is over. Not this time.
这一轮结束了，这次没成。
Not yet. Your letters stay; change a few and try again.
还没猜对。已填的字会保留，换几个再试。
Fill the %lld open slots in order.
按顺序填满 %lld 个空格。
Tap a letter to fill the first empty slot. Tap a filled slot to return its letter.
点候选字，填进第一个空格；点已填的格子，字退回候选区。
Returns this letter to the choices
提示已去掉 %lld 个干扰字。
Report a problem with this stage
Done. You’ve uncovered this stop’s secret.
成了。这一站的秘密，被你轻轻揭开。
Not this time. The story remembers that you tried.
这一次没能成，故事记下了你的尝试。
还差一点。换个思路，再试一次。
Your choice is now part of the story.
你的选择，已经写进了故事里。
Your photo is in. The result will follow.
照片已经收下，结果稍后揭晓。
The path hasn’t forked yet. Give it a moment.
前面的路还没有分岔，稍等片刻。
The search picture is on its way
The deck is shuffled. Draw a card.
There are no cards to draw right now.
这副牌暂时没有可抽的了。
